notes_for_editor: Name conflict unresolved: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives J.B. Jenkins, Forest Lookouts quotes the 7/8/1915 Idaho County Free Press as Jinkins. The newspaper itself was not read. Only one watcher is named across the sources. No visit report or photo was found for the present site, so the today section says none describes it. The Forest Service list (Schacher, April 2010) is compiled from Ray Kresek's book. Brief access unknown is kept; only the hike-in label is recorded.
